ModMetaData.name: RimLogging
ModMetaData.author: RimWorks
ModMetaData.description:
A public logging framework for RimWorld mods.
Replaces vanilla and Unity logging with a structured, channel-based, multi-sink pipeline. It has hierarchical channels (XML-defined or transient), Serilog-style templated messages with structured context, and an expression-based filter DSL.
Other mods can depend on this and call RimWorks.RimLogging.Log.Info / Warn / Error / Fatal directly. Vanilla Verse.Log and UnityEngine.Debug.Log calls are also captured and routed through the framework.
A three-pane in-game log viewer ships with this mod: a channel tree, level toggles, the filter DSL, and a one-click bug-report bundle. The detail pane docks to the bottom, docks to the right, or pops out into its own window.
Distributed as both a Steam Workshop dependency mod and a NuGet package. MIT licensed.
